newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHILTON TAKES COACHING JOB AT MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHILTON TAKES COACHING JOB AT MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Former England international Peter Shilton joined Middlesbrough on Tuesday as a part-time goalkeeping coach, the first division club said.
Shilton, a former England colleague of Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson, retired from active soccer last season aged 47 and after more than 1,000 league matches.
The veteran's last club was third division Leyton Orient, who said they were reluctantly letting him go because he could no longer kick the ball far enough.
